verdict.rationale: Glama documents automating workflows with schedules or webhooks, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack shows that users can version, review, or roll back those automations. The /v1 API path versioning and the deprecation flags concern Glama's own directory API, and GitHub-based image builds concern hosted MCP servers; neither is versioning or rollback of user automations, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
